seoDescription: Forsyth County Schools starts Aug. 5, 2027, and ends May 25, 2028. See major breaks, online-learning days, the official PDF, and an .ics download.
heroSummary: Forsyth County Schools starts classes Thursday, August 5, 2027, and the last day is Thursday, May 25, 2028. Fall Break is September 27–October 1, students are off November 22–26 for Thanksgiving week, Holiday Break is December 20–31, and Spring Break is April 3–7.
calendarNotes: The official Forsyth County Schools 2027–28 student calendar lists 178 student days: 85 in the first semester and 93 in the second semester. K–12 early-release days are September 3, December 17, May 24, and May 25. Online learning and parent conference dates are October 15 and March 17. Professional development days when students do not attend are October 18, January 3, February 22, and March 20.

compareIntro: Forsyth starts three calendar days later than Atlanta Public Schools, Cobb County School District, and Fulton County Schools. Forsyth shares its Fall Break dates with Fulton and has the same Thanksgiving, late-December, and Spring Break dates as all three districts.

sourceReviewSummary: This page is based on the official Forsyth County Schools 2027–28 student calendar and the district calendar page.
sourceReviewDetails: We check this page against the district's published first day, last day, major breaks, holidays, online learning and parent conference dates, early-release dates, and professional development days shown in the official source.

If we find a mismatch, we correct the page and update the review date. Campus-specific bell schedules, testing dates, staff details, and program events may appear only in the official PDF or individual school calendars.
The official district calendar remains the source of record for later changes.

customSections.label: Dates to Plan Around
customSections.content: The dates below either shorten the school day, replace in-person classes, or extend a student break.

groups.label: Schedule changes
items: Friday, September 3, is a K–12 early-release day before the Labor Day weekend. Monday, September 6, is the Labor Day holiday.
Friday, October 15, is a K–12 online learning and parent conference day. Monday, October 18, is a student holiday for staff professional development.
Friday, March 17, is a K–12 online learning and parent conference day. Monday, March 20, is a student holiday for staff professional development.

groups.label: Break return dates
items: Students return Tuesday, January 4, after the January 3 professional development day.
After the February 18–21 student and staff holiday and the February 22 professional development day, students return Wednesday, February 23.

groups.label: Early-release times
items: Early-release times vary by school group. Elementary I schools dismiss at 11:50 a.m., Elementary II schools at 12:30 p.m., middle schools at 1:30 p.m., high schools at 12:55 p.m., and Alliance Academy at 12:20 p.m.

customSections.label: Changes from the 2026–27 Calendar
customSections.content: The 2027–28 calendar starts one day earlier, ends two days earlier, adds a fourth K–12 early-release day, and moves Spring Break to April 3–7.

rows: School starts August 5 instead of August 6
Classes begin Thursday, August 5, one day earlier than in 2026–27.
School ends May 25 instead of May 27
The school year ends Thursday, May 25, rather than Thursday, May 27.
K–12 early-release days increase from three to four
May 24 is an additional K–12 early-release day, followed by another early release on the final student day, May 25.
Spring Break runs April 3–7 instead of April 5–9.
